chosen.name: d_DD|top20_each|stop10|hi50|D
chosen.description: Hold each top-20 member separately (fixed 1/N slot, cash when off); go to cash after a 10% fall from the highest close since entry, re-enter on a new 50-day closing high; decided daily, traded on change days plus a weekly drift rebalance.

a_VT.name: a_VT|btc|vt60|win20|D

b_RF.name: b_RF|top20|btc>ma50|D
